vision.name: Blue Malicious Blast
vision.text:
ENDURANCE 2.
(Villains only.)
[Attack] Energy attack costing 3 stages.
This attack cannot be stopped by an Event card. Raise or lower a player's anger 2 levels.
DAMAGE: 5 life cards.
HIT: Cards in your discard pile are considered Styled this turn.
(Banish after use.)
(Created by Cody Steenmeijer, OP2 South Kai Champion)
